svg.text: SR-002 Beam-wall section, diagnostic results and remaining design gates
SIMULATED COORDINATION REVIEW CASE STUDY | NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION | 2026-09-13
Source: Architectural model / verified structural interfaces | SHA256 e0b0102fe76c91c587e7... | units: m unless stated
Retained structural scheme; architectural package, finishes, reinforcement and foundation design remain open.
Section through the B-line rear-bay beam at 2F. Concrete outlines are unchanged; the analytical web centroid is corrected.
B-Y-B-23-2F / transverse section / 1:9.52
Web centre +3.56
Soffit +3.30
Web: 0.40 x 0.52 m; centroid 0.44 m below SSL.
Slab flange: 0.18 m; no second full-depth beam section.
Beam-owned overlap leaves 0.17 m wall at this section.
Remaining wall midplane x = 6.285 m; corner/contact offsets are explicit.
ACCOUNTING CORRECTION
Wall / column: 2.05920 m3
Wall / beam web: 2.00928 m3
Total counted once: 4.06848 m3 / 97.64352 kN
This is duplicated accounting removed, not physical concrete saved.
DIAGNOSTIC ANALYSIS RESULTS
Service gravity: 11878.409 kN
Max vertical displacement: 3.0484 mm
First period: 0.182024 s
Direct wall-frame intersections: 31; MPCs: 2323
REMAINING DESIGN
Code wind/earthquake and combinations; cracking and system checks;
all-member reinforcement, stairs/joints and anchorage;
soil/foundations, coherent bar drawings and schedules;
priced quantities, congestion and construction feasibility.
100 kN cases use uniform floor-area distribution, independent of mesh mass. They are not wind or earthquake actions.
The -1.80 m fixed base is diagnostic. Synthetic equipment inputs and uncracked elastic stiffness are not final design criteria.
Use with AR-001/002 and the structural report. These are coordination/review sheets; reinforcement is not drawn or approved.
